Name: CITYWD 21R
Comment: WRKH887 Citywide 700, OPEN (myGMRS University Park, ~35 mi; RB Dallas, 30 mi). Input DCS 503 / output DCS 263 (RB public list ID 2358). This CSV header has no RxDtcsCode: DtcsCode=503 encodes the uplink only; set Cross/Rx DCS 263 in CHIRP if you want output decode. Source: https://www.repeaterbook.com/gmrs/details.php?state_id=48&ID=2358 and https://mygmrs.com/repeater/12210 (tone not shown until login). Site GPS not published; distance uses University Park centroid.

Name: WHTROCK 15R
Comment: WQUM597 White Rock 550 (K5YR / WA5WRL), OPEN to GMRS licensees. Input and output CTCSS 141.3 (travel tone). Club post 29 Jun 2024: TX 462.550 / RX 467.550 with CTCSS 141.3, often labeled 15R. Sources: https://whiterockhams.wordpress.com/2024/06/29/lake-area-gmrs-repeater-on-the-air/ and RB ID 1391 (https://www.repeaterbook.com/gmrs/details.php?state_id=48&ID=1391). RB GPS 32.8385,-96.7131. Coverage listed as lake/neighborhoods ~4 mi.

Name: BIGBLUE 22R
Comment: WRKH887 Big Blue 725, OPEN (myGMRS Los Colinas; RB On-Air). Uplink DCS 031N, downlink CSQ / tone off (published on the public RB detail coverage/notes for ID 2452; list page showed only /CSQ). Tone=DTCS encodes 031; leave RX unsquelched or CSQ. Source: https://www.repeaterbook.com/gmrs/details.php?state_id=48&ID=2452 and https://www.mygmrs.com/repeater/12212 (tone hidden until login). Site: 23-story Las Colinas building, ~30-40 mi mobile; distance uses Las Colinas neighborhood centroid, not a specific tower.

Name: NTX 18R

Input and output CTCSS 127.3 (RB public list ID 2455; coverage text: Irving, managed by WRKH887). myGMRS NTX.625 (https://www.mygmrs.com/repeater/11907) is also Irving / OPEN but lists owner WSLZ549; tones there are not public without login. Source: https://www.repeaterbook.com/gmrs/details.php?state_id=48&ID=2455. Site GPS not published; distance uses Irving city centroid.

Name: FREEDOM 19R
Comment: WRKH887 Freedom 650, OPEN (myGMRS Irving, ~25 mi; RB 15-20 mi). Input DCS 627 / output DCS 156 (RB public list; IDs 2453 Irving and 2456 Dallas appear to be the same Irving machine). This CSV header has no RxDtcsCode: DtcsCode=627 encodes the uplink only; set Cross/Rx DCS 156 in CHIRP for output decode. Sources: https://www.repeaterbook.com/gmrs/details.php?state_id=48&ID=2453 and https://mygmrs.com/repeater/12211 (tone hidden until login). Site GPS not published; distance uses Irving city centroid.

Name: DCR 17R
Comment: Dallas County REACT DCR Channel 3, 462.600+ PL141.3. Official comms page publishes input PL 141.3 only (output tone not published), so Tone=encode, not TSQL. History: GMRS repeaters on buildings in downtown Dallas, owned by React Communications Corporation for the use and benefit of DCR (intra-team; amateur DCR machines are separately described as open). myGMRS 'Preston 600' (University Park / Dallas, WRKH887 or WRKH877) is marked REACT Only or members-only; its tone is not public and was not assumed to be this machine. Sources: https://www.dallasreact.org/communications and https://www.dallasreact.org/history. Distance uses downtown Dallas, approximate.

Name: DCR 20R
Comment: Dallas County REACT DCR Channel 1, 462.675+ PL141.3. Official comms page publishes input PL 141.3 only (output tone not published), so Tone=encode, not TSQL. History: downtown Dallas buildings, RCC-owned for DCR use (not listed as an open GMRS machine). Sources: https://www.dallasreact.org/communications and https://www.dallasreact.org/history. Distance uses downtown Dallas, approximate.

Name: GEFORCE 20R
Comment: WRKH887 Geforce 675 (RB: GEFORCE 675 1 of 3). Input and output DCS 025 (RB public list ID 2359). Request access or confirm on-air practice before transmitting. A related myGMRS XForce Connect 675 listing is Members Only. Source: https://www.repeaterbook.com/gmrs/details.php?state_id=48&ID=2359. Site GPS not published; distance uses Dallas city center and is only a rough rank.
